help.title: How Cairn Table works
help.intro: Cairn Table is a free, open tool for the tabletop RPG Cairn. Build an adventurer, run a table, connect players — all in the browser, no account.
help.what.title: What is this?
help.what.body: A character sheet plus a Warden dashboard with serverless real-time multiplayer. Play solo to keep a sheet, or open a room so the Warden sees every player live and can push damage, saves, rests and items to them.
help.storage.title: Storage & privacy
help.storage.body: Your character lives only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Export/import is a manual JSON file. Multiplayer connects browsers directly (peer-to-peer, encrypted); game data never passes through a server. No cookies, no analytics.
help.sheet.title: The character sheet
help.sheet.body: Cairn has no hit points. Hit Protection (HP) is your knack for dodging blows — a short rest restores it fully. Your three attributes STR/DEX/WIL (3–18) are the real health: at 0 HP, damage falls through to STR, and STR 0 means dead. When HP hits exactly 0 you roll on the Scars table. Deprived (no food or rest) blocks all recovery; DEX or WIL at 0 leaves you paralyzed or delirious until it's restored. A short line under your traits sums up your look and manner once you've filled a few in.
help.inventory.title: Inventory
help.inventory.body: Ten slots: four worn/in hand, six in the backpack. Most items take one slot, bulky items two, petty items none. Fatigue (from casting, hunger, hardship) is a card that fills a slot — fill all ten and you drop to 0 HP. A night's or week's rest clears all Fatigue. Drag items between slots.
help.dice.title: Dice
help.dice.body: Attacks always hit — just roll the weapon die, subtract armour. A save is d20 ≤ the attribute (1 always passes, 20 always fails). Fighting from weakness is Impaired (d4); from advantage, Enhanced (d12). Multiple attackers on one target: roll all, keep the highest.
help.mp.title: Playing together
help.mp.body: The Warden clicks ‘Host’ and shares the 4-letter room code or the invite link. Players join, and their sheets appear live on the Warden's dashboard. If a connection drops it reconnects automatically; a reload mid-session restores it.
help.warden.title: Warden tools
help.warden.body: Per player: deal damage (runs the full chain), heal, give or take gold, demand a save, add Fatigue, toggle Deprived or Panicked (attacks auto-impair), trigger a rest, whisper. Plus a round log shared with the table, a combat tracker with the 2e bestiary or your own saved monsters, a shared loot pool and named containers (mule, cart, hirelings) with a one-click give to any player, and secret per-player notes that stay on your machine.
help.map.title: The map
help.map.body: The Warden loads a map image, places tokens (connected players at the press of a button, plus markers and revealed foes), drags measurements, paints radii for spell effects, and runs the fog of war: “Cover all”, then drag areas and reveal them to the party. Players only see the revealed part and their own token; in “Moves checked” mode they propose moves for confirmation. Several named maps are possible (the active one goes to everyone). Everything lives in the Warden's browser and survives a reload.
help.rules.title: Rules & licence
help.rules.body: Rule data is derived from the Cairn 2nd Edition SRD by Yochai Gal, used under CC BY-SA 4.0. Effect texts are summarised, not copied. Cairn Table's code is MIT. It is an independent fan tool, not affiliated with Cairn RPG.
dice.advHouseRule: House rule, not Cairn RAW: Cairn has no "roll twice, take the better/worse d20" advantage/disadvantage mechanic. RAW, the Warden handles this through the fiction — an adjusted target, a waived save, a different consequence.
res.hpInfo: Cairn has no hit points. HP is your knack for dodging and deflecting blows — not health. At 0 HP, damage falls through to STR; STR 0 means dead. A short rest restores HP fully.
res.gpInfo: A bag of coins worth less than 100 gp is petty and takes no slot.
res.goldSlotsInfo: Optional switch for the core rule: at 100 gp the bag counts as an item. One extra slot per 100 gp (off = as usual, no slot).
res.deprivedInfo: Lacking food or rest. Cannot recover HP, attributes or slots. Adds Fatigue each day.
res.criticalInfo: Critically wounded — can only crawl. Dies within the hour unless stabilized (e.g. bandages).
res.panickedInfo: Surrounded by enemies, in darkness, or facing your greatest fear: HP is 0, no action in the first round of combat, all attacks impaired. A WIL save as an action ends the panic.
res.paralyzedInfo: DEX reduced to 0 — paralyzed and unable to act until extended rest or extraordinary means restore the attribute.
res.deliriousInfo: WIL reduced to 0 — delirious and unable to act until extended rest or extraordinary means restore the attribute.
